jei.larperthanwolves.info.silicon_shard: Silicon Shards are obtained by breaking Gravel blocks in the world (8% chance) or by sifting Gravel and Sand in a Sieve. 4 Silicon Shards craft into 1 Flint.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.flint: Flint cannot be obtained directly from gravel drops. Obtain Silicon Shards from gravel or sifting, then craft 4 Shards into 1 Flint in a 2x2 grid.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.gravel: Breaking Gravel drops Gravel blocks, Silicon Shards (8%), or Copper Dust (5%). Process Gravel in a Sieve for additional resources.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.crafting_table: Crafting Tables cannot be crafted in inventory. Right-click any tree stump or log in the world 4 times with a Chisel to carve a Crafting Table.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.work_stump: An intermediate stage of carving a tree stump into a Crafting Table using a Chisel.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.chisel: Used to carve tree stumps and logs into Work Stumps and Crafting Tables, as well as crafting wooden components.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.unfired_brick: Unfired Bricks can be smelted in a Brick Furnace or placed in the world exposed to direct sunlight to dry into Bricks naturally over time.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.brick: Obtained by smelting Unfired Bricks in a Brick Furnace or drying Unfired Brick blocks under direct sunlight.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.brick_furnace: Replaces the vanilla furnace. Accepts logs, planks, coal, charcoal, sticks, dry grass, and rope. Must be manually ignited with a Lighter or Flint and Steel.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.alloy_mixer: Used to mix metal alloys (such as Bronze and Diamond Ingots). Place fuel in the bottom slot and ignite with a Lighter or Flint and Steel.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.lighter: Crafted early from sticks. Used to ignite Brick Furnaces, Alloy Mixers, and start fires.
jei.larperthanwolves.drying_rack.conditi: Place outdoors in daylight under open sky
jei.larperthanwolves.info.drying_rack: Crafted in a 2x2 grid using 4 sticks. Place outdoors in daytime without blocks above to passively dry grass into Dry Grass and leather into Tanned Leather.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.dry_grass: Obtained by harvesting grass with shears and drying it on a Drying Rack outdoors under sunlight. Used to craft early ropes and as furnace fuel.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.tanned_leather: Obtained by placing regular leather on a Drying Rack outdoors under sunlight. Used to craft leather armor sets and sturdy ropes.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.axe_planks: Logs cannot be turned into planks by hand in the 2x2 inventory grid. Combine any axe with wood or logs to obtain 2 planks (the axe loses 1 durability). On a 3x3 Crafting Table, wood yields 4 planks without requiring an axe.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.hoe_tilling: Right-click grass blocks with any hoe to till away grass into dirt with a 35% chance to discover wild seeds (Wheat Seeds, Carrots, Potatoes, Beetroot Seeds, Pumpkin Seeds, Melon Seeds). Right-click plain dirt with a hoe to prepare Farmland for planting.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.villager_trade: Villager armorers, weaponsmiths, and toolsmiths trade equipment up to Bronze tier in exchange for Emeralds. Basic items can be bartered with villagers and wandering traders.
jei.larperthanwolves.info.iron_golem: Iron Golems protect villages and drop only poppies upon defeat. They do not drop iron ingots.
